chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Joining the Cats and the Fiddle; the Apollo
summary: Snags Allen turned down the guitar job and recommended him; the group, with its hit I Miss You So, played the Apollo, close behind the Ink Spots.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Cats & the Fiddle -- had they been looking for an electric guitar player

That part I don't know. But the thing of it is they offered it to Snags, the same guy I was talkin' about. And somehow or other he didn't want to leave town or he had something, I forgot. Anyhow, he referred me. And I really gave 'em an audition, in a way of speaking. They say we gonna get together & we hear you play, and they heard me play & the band say 'yeah.' -- By the way, they didn't know if I could sing or not...
So they were happy and they talk to me, but man the money I got was -- mmmh! Nothin'. But anyhow I was happy to get off

the ground ... big time group -- first thing we hit was the Apollo Theater. I couldn't believe I was on the stage -- sittin' up there lookin' out. But they went over, they went over very good, 'cause they had this hit song, I Miss You So.
Was that one of the first jobs you played with them, at the Apollo Theater?

When we started off -- No, I think we went to Chicago or somewhere. They had to break me in good first, you know. But the first job I think we went to Chicago, 'cause he had a couple of cars [?]. We returned to the Apollo Theater -- it was packed, cause it was between the Ink Spots and ourselves, running neck and neck. The Ink Spots were ahead, not neck and neck. They were ahead, but we were right on their heels. They took off, boy.
